name: carvcam-desktop
description: CarvCAM for Mac, Windows and Linux: the gsender-ui app in Electron, talking to gSender

scripts.prepare-build: npm run renderer && npm run icons
scripts.dist: npm run prepare-build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prepare-build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare-build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run prepare-build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --linux --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:pi: npm run prepare-build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --linux --arm64 --armv7l --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: npm run prepare-build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --dir --publish never
